bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true
active="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")"
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-final-1cae702)"
test "$active" = "$expected"
echo GAYBBS_FINAL_IMAGE=PASS
docker exec "$name" test -f /app/gaybbs.mjs
echo LINK_ROUTE_SOURCE_DEPLOYED=PASS
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||COALESCE(message_id::text,'NONE')||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;"
echo GAYBBS_RUNNING=PASS
